p: Mill Rythe sits on the north-eastern side of Hayling Island, overlooking Chichester Harbour, so it's a lovely spot for a peaceful break with plenty of birdlife around. The island's long beaches are on the south coast, a short drive from the park.

For a walk or a bike ride, the Hayling Billy Trail follows the line of the old railway along the west side of the island, with views over Langstone Harbour. From Ferry Point at the western tip of the island, the little foot ferry crosses to Eastney when it's running, which makes a day out in Southsea surprisingly easy without the car.
There's also the Hayling Seaside Railway, a narrow gauge line running along the seafront, which is a hit with small kids.
